data.narrative:
Seasats is a Series A–stage company operating in the Ocean & Maritime sector. The company has raised approximately $40M to date and is led by CEO Mike Flanigan alongside co-founders Dan Flanigan, Dylan Rodriguez (CTO), and Max Kramers. The comparable universe for this frontier-tech segment is limited, consisting of two private peers—Bedrock Ocean and Havoc AI—with no directly comparable public companies available for reference.

The stage-progression method is applicable to this valuation. Using total capital raised ($40M) as a proxy for current enterprise value, a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A progression to later-stage funding rounds yields an implied valuation of $80M. This single-method triangulation establishes a central estimate, though the limited comp universe constrains confidence in cross-validation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $68M to $92M, centered at $80M. The lower bound reflects downside scenarios accounting for execution risk and nascent market traction; the upper bound incorporates upside contingent on achieving near-term operational milestones. Key uncertainties include the relative maturity and funding trajectory of the two private comparables, the absence of public market benchmarks for the Ocean & Maritime tech subsector, and limited visibility into Seasats' revenue or customer metrics. Additional due diligence on unit economics and market penetration would strengthen conviction in this range.
